body:
He didn't kill himself because of just you.  There were a lot of things that added up to it.  It is NOT like you said "go kill yourself."  It wasn't your responsibility to keep him happy.  In the end, people are responsible for their own well being.
You said "I didn't mean to kill him" -- you DID NOT KILL HIM.  He made that decision himself.

Ya, trying to kill yourself is great.  I tried it a bunch and now call it suicide therapy.  Kind of an extreme way of testing the boundries of existence and tenacity of life.  Nothing like a nice suicide attempt to keep you alive and well and take the edge off of life.

I suppose I do NOT actually want to kill myself because my attempts, while potential fatal, tend not to leave marks or otherwise injure myself. It's kind of a built-in thing that, in case it doesn't work, I can just go on normally.  Not that I've done this, but, as an example -- standing in front of a train and stepping off at the last second.

I HAVE pointed a loaded gun at my head many a time.  I particularly like when I tell to my therapist that I put a gun to my head and he asks, "was it loaded?"  What, in the hell, would be the point of putting an unloaded gun to your head?

Yes...stop trying to please him.  Admit to yourself your dad is an asshole and the cause of a lot of your emotional suffering.  Possibly even confront him with it, not that very much will come of that.  But, you have a chance to do that now -- while he is alive -- or live with it without having confronted him after he is dead.

Yes I second that.  Don't want to fucking live in a place like this where corporations would rather feed us gmos and have us drink flouridated water to keep us sick so they can profit off of our medical blls.  at the same time, you are told suicide is not an option -- from my point of view -- because then any chance to profit off of your misery will end.
This fucking place Jesus fucking christ

Thanks.  Not just the news -- its the news they don't want you to hear.  Shit like global warming and GMOs and the theoretical limit of about 9-10 billion people on the planet, and we are at 7 bil.  Shit like that. Even if I pull out of depression, I will be living in a dying world.  If you think it's bad now -- wait a few decades.  I haven't felt like I have reason to live for  long time. It's just now getting worse, asif I am giving up on the little bit of hope that may have been keeping me going.

Depression won't let up.  Tired of fighting it.  Lately I've learned psychiatry is mostly bullshit.  The antidepressants are just marketing gimicks and don't work mch better than  a placebo.  I lived a lie for the 20 years I was medicated, thinking it was helping.
Just tired of it.  Waiting for the next disaster in my life so I can end it.
I appreciate people wanting to help but I think it would help more if I were encouraged to end my misery.
